subject: Fast-path top-up: credit ask and pricing options
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@pulseai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Fast-path top-up — options and a short credit ask

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the quick sync on Friday. We saw the usage spike you anticipated and sketched three short-cycle top-up options that let PulseAI absorb the extra traffic while keeping your renewal co-term intact. I attached a short spreadsheet (pulse_topup_options_v2.xlsx) with the numbers; summary below: 

- Option A — Immediate add-on (30% uplift) with standard unit price; full invoice pro-rated for remainder of term.
- Option B — Immediate add-on with 10% Q4 voucher (applied as credit on next invoice) in exchange for 6-month commitment to the higher tier.
- Option C — Short-term burst capacity (30 days) at higher unit rate but no change to renewal seat counts.

Two asks from our side to fast-track:
1) Can procurement confirm whether a short PO (covering Option B or A) is possible this month?
2) Would PulseAI accept a voucher-style credit (Option B) rather than an upfront discount to keep revenue recognition clean?

Marcus is looped for pricing if you want us to tighten the numbers. If you can indicate a preference by 11/24 we can prepare a short amendment and DocuSign link this week.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pulse_topup_options_v2.xlsx
From: Emma Li <emma.li@pulseai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@pulseai.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fast-path top-up — options and a short credit ask

Sofia —

Appreciate the clear options. PulseAI is leaning toward Option B (voucher applied to Q4) because it fits our current budgeting (we can commit to the 6-month uplift if credits are visible). A couple notes from procurement: 

- We need a simple amendment that doesn't change our renewal trigger date (co-term required).
- Procurement will target PO issuance by 11/30 if the amendment and invoice are finalized this week. Attached is a brief timeline from our side (pulse_po_timing.pdf).

One question: can the voucher be capped to dollars not to token usage? That makes internal forecasting simpler for us.

Emma Li
Head of Platform Ops, PulseAI
emma.li@pulseai.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:42:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Fast-path top-up — options and a short credit ask

Sofia / team —

Thanks for the note and the timeline from PulseAI. Given procurement's preference for a dollar-capped voucher, here's a recommended path that balances revenue and conversion risk: 

- Offer: Option B variant — $40k voucher applied to next invoice (cap, non-transferable), tied to a 6-month temporary uplift (no change to the renewal date).
- Pricing concession: 10% off incremental unit price for the uplift period (applies before voucher).
- Invoice flow: Issue an amendment + short invoice for the committed uplift; voucher posts as credit on the following invoice (visible on statement).

Rationale: preserves co-term, keeps recognition straightforward, and gives PulseAI line-of-sight. If procurement is willing to PO for the amendment by 11/30 we can finalize.

I ran quick numbers and attached a simple calc (pricing_calc_q4.csv). If Ben wants a slightly deeper discount for a multi-year auto-renewal qualifier we can add that as a follow-up.

Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_calc_q4.csv
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@pulseai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, procurement@pulseai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Final proposal: $40k voucher + 10% uplift discount (amendment/docusign)

Emma —

Following up with a concise path so procurement can action: 

Summary (final):
- PulseAI selects Option B variant.
- Immediate uplift: +30% capacity for 6 months (no change to renewal/co-term).
- Pricing: 10% off incremental rate for uplift period.
- Credit: $40,000 voucher applied as dollar credit to the invoice AFTER the amendment invoice (non-refundable, expires 12/31/2027).

Next steps we will take:
1) I will generate a 1-page amendment reflecting the terms above.
2) DocuSign envelope (short amendment + signature) — link below.
3) On execution, Redwood will issue the invoice for the uplift commit (pro-rated). Voucher posts on the subsequent invoice.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/TP/Sign?xyz=doc-4931
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765

Please confirm by EOD 11/24 if that works; procurement indicated PO by 11/30 once amendment is signed. Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk the flow.

Best —
Sofia
